record.paper_title: Billiard Dynamics: A Survey with the Emphasis on Open Problems
record.original_question: Construct a planar billiard table with positive entropy in either of the following regularity classes: (a) a strictly convex table whose boundary is C1-smooth, or (b) a convex table whose boundary is C2-smooth.

evidence.quote: By the (metric) entropy of a billiard we mean the entropy of the Liouville measure.
Problem 2. a) Construct a strictly convex C1-smooth billiard table with positive entropy. b) Construct a convex C2-smooth billiard table with positive entropy.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a planar billiard table, that is, a compact connected planar domain Ω ⊂ ℝ² with non-empty interior whose boundary ∂Ω is a piecewise smooth simple closed curve. The billiard flow describes a point particle moving in straight lines inside Ω at unit speed and reflecting elastically (angle of incidence equals angle of reflection) upon hitting ∂Ω. This flow preserves the Liouville measure on the unit tangent bundle of Ω; define the (metric) entropy of the billiard to be the Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy of the billiard flow with respect to this Liouville measure.

Solve either of the following:

(a) Construct a strictly convex planar billiard table Ω whose boundary ∂Ω is a C¹-smooth simple closed curve and whose billiard has positive metric entropy.

(b) Construct a convex planar billiard table Ω whose boundary ∂Ω is a C²-smooth simple closed curve and whose billiard has positive metric entropy.

(Here "strictly convex" means the curvature of ∂Ω, where defined, is strictly positive; "convex" allows flat pieces.)
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of explicitly constructing a smooth convex (C² or strictly convex C¹) billiard table with positive metric (Liouville) entropy appears to remain open. A 2024 result establishes that billiards in a generic (C² open and dense) set of convex bodies have positive topological entropy and exponential growth of periodic orbits, but this is a genericity statement about topological entropy, not an explicit construction yielding positive Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy with respect to the Liouville measure.

status_evidence.title: Billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy
status_evidence.snippet: There exists a C² open dense set of convex bodies with smooth boundary whose billiard map exhibits a non-trivial hyperbolic basic set; consequently billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy.
status_evidence.claim: Generic C² convex bodies have positive topological entropy, but the problem of explicit constructions with positive metric entropy is not resolved by this result.

status_evidence.title: Billiard dynamics: An updated survey with the emphasis on open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Problem: construct a strictly convex C¹-smooth billiard table with positive entropy; construct a convex C²-smooth billiard table with positive entropy.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed as an open problem in an updated billiard dynamics survey.
